title: Worksheet 5: Robux Scams
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Robux is the virtual currency used inside Roblox to buy special items, accessories, and upgrades for a player's avatar or games. Because Robux normally costs real money to buy, some scammers try to trick players into believing they can get free Robux outside of Roblox's official store. Common scam tricks include websites or messages promising "free Robux generators," offers to trade real Robux for a player's account password, or fake giveaways that ask a player to enter personal account information on an outside website. These scams do not actually give players free Robux; instead, they are designed to steal a player's account, personal information, or even a parent's real money. Roblox has stated clearly that there is no legitimate way to get free Robux outside of its official purchasing system, and any website or message claiming otherwise should be treated as a scam. If a player ever encounters one of these offers, the safest choice is to avoid clicking any links and tell a trusted adult.
